title: Teacher union demonstration at Central Square over salaries and education conditions
location: Central Square, Ulaanbaatar (exact formal toponym not resolved in the inspected local reports)
scope: One Ulaanbaatar gathering is reported; related participation in aimags is mentioned but not unitized or pooled.
organizer: Education and Science Trade Union; exact role of national/local branches not fully established.

state_target.target: Mongolian state, including Parliament Speaker, Prime Minister and Education Ministry, over teacher salary and education policy.
state_target.evidence: iToim/iSee report the salary and social-guarantee demands were delivered to national officials.

demands_original: Increase teachers’ base salary to 3.5 million tugrik and improve social guarantees/working conditions; education funding concerns also reported.
participants_original: Teachers from Ulaanbaatar districts and aimags; GoGo reports >30 teachers from Darkhan-Uul as one contingent only. Total Ulaanbaatar attendance is unknown.
threshold_50_evidence: No contemporary inspected local source gives a total Ulaanbaatar site count. More than 30 teachers from Darkhan-Uul is a subgroup and does not establish ≥50 at the site; aimag counts are not pooled.

start_date.summary: All three local reports date the demonstration to 2025-09-24.

location.summary: GoGo/iSee place the teachers' gathering at Ulaanbaatar central square; formal site name is not uniform.

scope.summary: One central-square gathering is directly documented. Nationwide/aimag participation does not prove one simultaneous multi-site unit.

organizer.summary: The Education and Science Trade Union is named as organizing body; local branch relationship not resolved.

state_target.summary: Demands delivered to the Speaker and Prime Minister; salary and social policy are state-directed.

demands.summary: Base salary increase and social guarantees/working conditions; code labor_wage_dispute only.

participants_original.summary: iToim identifies teachers from districts/aimags; GoGo reports >30 Darkhan-Uul teachers as a contingent, not the total crowd.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No source reports total attendance at Ulaanbaatar site; the Darkhan-Uul subgroup cannot establish threshold.

protester_violence.summary: Local reports describe the demonstration as peaceful.

state_response.summary: Education Minister spoke at the gathering about budget planning; no agreement or formal accommodation is established.

end_date.summary: The event is dated Sep 24, but no inspected local report establishes actual end time/date or later continuity.

notes: The current Education International page version is post-cutoff as corrected in the linked note and is not used for attendance/demand coding. No expected turnout or across-site counts were substituted for attendance.
open_questions: Did at least 50 people participate simultaneously at the Central Square site?
Were local aimag gatherings simultaneous, and what were the separate site counts?
Was the September march a continuation of the August Ministry gathering or a distinct episode?
Did the sit-down reported in an Oct 7 search result continue this September event, and when did it end?
Did the Minister's interaction constitute formal consideration or accommodation of demands?
